identity: Conventional ammunition-fed close-range defense.
strengths: broad PDS target eligibility; conventional installation; reaction-capacity growth
weaknesses: finite ammunition; accuracy and ammunition burden
tuning_knobs: accuracy; reaction capacity; ammunition efficiency; Tactical Power readiness; evasive compensation; reliability

identity: Power-intensive, ammunition-free close-range defense.
weaknesses: Tactical Power demand; sustained readiness competition
tuning_knobs: accuracy; reaction capacity; Tactical Power cost; evasive compensation; reliability

identity: Finite-ammunition interceptor PDS with strong missile-defense specialization while retaining common PDS target eligibility.
strengths: high missile-interception potential; independent interceptor package
weaknesses: finite ammunition; specialized opportunity cost
tuning_knobs: accuracy; reaction capacity; interceptor ammunition; Tactical Power readiness; reliability; target-specific modifiers only if explicitly approved

identity: Core-power continuity without ordinary Tactical Power output.
weaknesses: does not provide ordinary Tactical Power
tuning_knobs: continuity duration; reliability; capacity cost

identity: Finite emergency Tactical Power injection.
strengths: flexible short burst; simple emergency use
weaknesses: finite charges; does not replace reactor output
tuning_knobs: power per use; number of uses; once-per-turn limit; resupply; capacity cost; reliability

identity: Charge-then-discharge stored power assigned to a legal operation.
weaknesses: charging time; assignment limits
tuning_knobs: charge rate; stored power; eligible operation; discharge timing; reliability

identity: Renewable Tactical Power generation with high integration and capacity cost.
weaknesses: capacity 2 candidate; damage and containment risk; threshold-crossing risk
tuning_knobs: output; capacity cost; degraded output; cooldown; reliability; support requirements

identity: Finite emergency shield restoration.
weaknesses: finite charges; does not improve normal recharge
tuning_knobs: restoration amount; charges; activation timing; capacity cost; reliability

identity: Increases maximum shield capacity; optional overcharge remains stress-limited.
weaknesses: stress and power if overcharged; lost when disabled
tuning_knobs: capacity bonus; overcharge amount; power cost; stress chance; reliability

identity: Improves shield recharge efficiency per Tactical Power.
weaknesses: requires Tactical Power and an operating shield generator
tuning_knobs: recharge efficiency; power requirement; reliability

identity: Provides bounded Shield Protection or reduces shield-penetration effectiveness.
weaknesses: sustained power; high balance risk against weak attacks
tuning_knobs: Shield Protection; SPEN interaction; Tactical Power cost; capacity cost; reliability

identity: Expendable outer armor layer resolving before primary armor.
weaknesses: normally nonrepairable in combat; consumed by damage
tuning_knobs: Armor Protection; Armor Integrity; capacity cost; mass or maneuver tradeoff

identity: Consumes sustained Tactical Power to add an armor-protection bonus while passive armor remains intact when unpowered.
weaknesses: sustained power; brownout sensitivity
tuning_knobs: protection bonus; Tactical Power cost; reliability; capacity cost

identity: Supports the agreed full-turn evasive posture without changing movement allowance.
weaknesses: own-fire penalty; increased fuel cost; full-turn commitment
tuning_knobs: defense bonus; own-fire penalty; fuel multiplier; stationary cost; evasive compensation; reliability

identity: Improves active-search range and local reacquisition support.
weaknesses: emissions; Tactical Power when active
tuning_knobs: active range; reacquisition modifier; Tactical Power cost; reliability

identity: Degrades opposing track quality and participates in the agreed cooperative ECM screen.
weaknesses: sustained Tactical Power; observable emissions; ECCM counterplay
tuning_knobs: ECM strength; Tactical Power cost; cooperative-screen contribution; reliability

identity: Improves powered discrimination against ECM without revealing hidden enemy values.
weaknesses: sustained Tactical Power; situational value
tuning_knobs: ECCM strength; Tactical Power cost; reliability

identity: Supports datalink reach, coordination, and relay functions under line-of-sight and observer-safe information rules.
weaknesses: network stacking risk; line-of-sight and latency constraints
tuning_knobs: relay reach; latency; power cost; relay chaining; reliability

identity: Sustained high-power movement denial and hold effects under explicit conflict and cap rules.
weaknesses: high Tactical Power; capacity 2 candidate; control and stacking risk
tuning_knobs: hold strength; Tactical Power cost; range; capacity cost; conflict rules; reliability

identity: Human crews perform in-combat repair using Damage Control Capacity, supplies, tools, access, and procedures.
weaknesses: crew time; supplies; uncertain repair rolls
tuning_knobs: Damage Control Capacity; assistance; tools and access; supply efficiency; crew quality

identity: Robotic repair assistance and autonomous diagnostics augment, rather than replace, Damage Control allocation.
weaknesses: power or supplies; assistance cap; no free extra repair step
tuning_knobs: repair modifier; supply efficiency; assistance cap; Tactical Power; reliability

identity: Candidate nanotechnological, adaptive-material, biological, or comparable self-healing support; exact implementation remains unresolved.
weaknesses: power, material, reliability, or rate limits to be defined
tuning_knobs: repair rate; eligible damage; power; materials; reliability; capacity cost

identity: Adds shuttle or small-craft capacity under explicit launch, recovery, replacement, and boarding rules.
weaknesses: capacity 2 candidate; force-multiplication risk
tuning_knobs: craft capacity; launch/recovery tempo; capacity cost; support requirements

identity: Research, analysis, and discovery support with bounded strategic returns.
weaknesses: indirect combat value; diminishing returns
tuning_knobs: task bonus; throughput; time; power; diminishing returns

identity: Resource extraction constrained by site, time, cargo, and throughput.
weaknesses: time exposure; site and cargo limits
tuning_knobs: throughput; power; time; site cap; cargo interaction

identity: Converts compatible cargo or salvage into supplies using time, power, recipes, and material input.
weaknesses: capacity 2 candidate; anti-loop constraints; time and input cost
tuning_knobs: recipe efficiency; throughput; power; time; material compatibility

identity: Adds general cargo capacity within hull and mass limits.
weaknesses: low direct combat value; possible maneuver or signature tradeoff
tuning_knobs: cargo capacity; mass or maneuver cost; capacity cost

identity: Adds Kinetic ammunition reserve while loaded Ready Packages remain with their weapons.
